summary: Frontend-only testing of the new JMBG-history hint banner in both PersonModal (/fizicka-lica) and EmployeeModal (company detail > Zaposleni). All 6 requested scenarios PASSED. Login as getuard works. Existing JMBG 2301996220017 triggers banner in both modals with correct 'EGZON CEKA' + '2 zapošljavanja' text and latest company (PR. ARSIM CEKOVIĆ STR REA) + AKTIVAN badge. 'Popuni podatke' correctly auto-fills ime/prezime/adresa/grad/pozicija/strucna_sprema and shows a success toast. Banner correctly hidden for unknown JMBG (99999999999999), short JMBG (<8 chars) and in EDIT mode (verified both for a random person and specifically for the EGZON CEKA record). Backend GET /api/employees/history-by-jmbg?jmbg=2301996220017 verified via curl: count=2, history array with 2 records (auth required, returns 401 without token - correct). No DB pollution: all modals cancelled, person count remained 237.

issues: Date inputs ('Datum početka rada', 'Datum prestanka rada') use the native browser date picker showing US mm/dd/yyyy format instead of a shadcn/locale-aware date component - inconsistent with the Montenegrin dd.mm.yyyy convention used elsewhere. Pre-existing, not part of this change.
React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from Persons.jsx line ~284 (company filter <select> option contains a dynamic span wrapper). Console-only, no functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: applyHistoryData uses `form.x || historyHit.x` so it never overwrites already-typed values - good, non-destructive. Behavior confirmed in UI.
The debounce cleanup sets historyLoading=false on every keystroke, so the '🔍 Provjera JMBG-a...' loading hint flickers; consider a request-id guard. Cosmetic only.

Persons.jsx is 1134 lines and CompanyDetail.jsx >1100 lines - both exceed the 700-line guideline; the duplicated JMBG-history hook/banner/apply logic in the two files is a DRY violation (~60 lines duplicated) and should be extracted into a shared hook (e.g. useJmbgHistory) + <JmbgHistoryBanner/> component.
